name: @sailing-loong/magpie-bridge
description: Connect LoongPass accounts, rewards and expiring-credit-first model routing to Magpie

summary.en: Connect your running local LoongPass app: multi-account management, assisted reward claims, balances and expiry, and official-app switching where supported. Route models through eligible credits expiring first, using the same vendor account quotas as direct plugins. LoongPass installation required.
summary.zh: 连接本机 LoongPass，统一管理多平台多账号、辅助签到与奖励领取、余额和积分到期、官方 App 账号切换，并按适用积分到期时间优先选路。与直接插件共用原平台账号额度。需安装并运行 LoongPass，各平台能力以应用说明为准。
